note: Greenbone/OpenVAS equivalents of Rapid7 Nexpose/InsightVM and Tenable Nessus built-in scan templates. Settings are a contract checked by service_policy.validate_request; only allow-listed keys reach the scanner. 'seed_as_builtin' templates are created automatically as ready-to-use policies in every tenant. The template with 'default': true (Polaron policy) is preselected when a scan is launched and is used when a scan job names no policy.

templates.name: Polaron policy
templates.description: Default Polaron package. Nessus Basic Network Scan scope (Aetheris service port policy: 154 TCP / 33 UDP ports, Full and fast, safe checks) plus every port on which Nessus reported a finding in the Polaron solution sets (Core, RRP, RRP Electrical, Lilavati, Savarkar; Dec 2025 to Jul 2026): 138 TCP and 7 UDP report ports, of which 108 TCP and 2 UDP are not in Basic Network Scan. 262 TCP / 35 UDP ports in total.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Basic Network Scan settings (SYN scan, service detection on every open port, safe checks on, optimize tests on) on the Aetheris Basic Network Scan port scope, extended with the ports evidenced in the Polaron Nessus solution-set exports.
templates.reference: Polaron default package (catalog 1.4). Port evidence: 8 Nessus solution-set exports, 6,659 finding rows, 145 distinct protocol/port pairs (port 0 host-level findings excluded). Report ports are pinned explicitly in custom_tcp_ports/custom_udp_ports, so they stay in scope even if a service is disabled in the service port policy. Per-port evidence: POLARON_POLICY_PORT_MATRIX.xlsx.
templates.deviations: Greenbone/OpenVAS NVTs, not Tenable plugins; severities follow CVSS, not Nessus VPR. 18 report ports are Windows dynamic RPC or SQL Server named-instance ports (49152-65535) that the OS assigns per host and per restart; they are pinned for re-tests of the same hosts, while new hosts are found through 135/tcp (RPC endpoint mapper) and 1434/udp (SQL Server Browser), both in scope. Use Advanced Scan (all 65,535 TCP) when a host may run services on other unlisted ports. Missing-patch findings (MS16-047, MS17-010, unsupported OS) need an SMB credential, as in Nessus.

templates.name: Host Discovery
templates.description: Find live hosts, open ports, and operating systems. No vulnerability checks run.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Host Discovery: ARP/ICMP/TCP ping, common-port scan, OS identification, no vulnerability plugins.
templates.deviations: Greenbone 'Discovery' config also runs service and product detection on the catalog ports, which is slightly more than Nessus host discovery.
templates.reference: Nessus Host Discovery: ARP/ICMP/TCP ping, common-port scan, OS identification, no vulnerability plugins.

templates.name: Ping-Only Discovery
templates.description: Find which hosts are alive with minimal traffic. No port scan and no vulnerability checks.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Ping-Only Discovery: a simple scan to discover live hosts with minimal network traffic.
templates.deviations: Uses Greenbone's 'Host Discovery' config (alive detection only). Each host is reported alive or not alive; not-alive hosts are listed as skipped. ARP ping cannot cross Docker Desktop NAT, so a host that blocks ICMP and the TCP probe ports can look not alive from a laptop scanner.
templates.reference: Nessus Ping-Only Discovery: a simple scan to discover live hosts with minimal network traffic.

templates.name: Basic Network Scan
templates.description: Full system scan on the Nexus service ports (52 service families), service detection on every open port, safe checks only.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Basic Network Scan: port scan range 'default' (about 4,790 common TCP ports), SYN scanner, probe all open ports for services, UDP scanner off, safe checks on, optimize tests on.
templates.deviations: Scans the Nexus service-port catalog (about 88 TCP ports plus 30 priority UDP ports) instead of Nessus' ~4,790-port default, so services on unusual ports are not found. Choose 'IANA TCP list' or 'All TCP ports' in the policy for wider discovery. Explicitly authorized targets are treated as alive.
templates.reference: Nessus Basic Network Scan: port scan range 'default' (about 4,790 common TCP ports), SYN scanner, probe all open ports for services, UDP scanner off, safe checks on, optimize tests on.

templates.name: Advanced Scan
templates.description: All 65,535 TCP ports plus priority UDP, safe checks only. Use when hosts may run services on unusual ports.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Advanced Scan: every setting configurable; commonly run with port range 1-65535 and safe checks on.
templates.deviations: Plugin-family selection is available through nvt_families; when Greenbone rejects the family selection the full 'Full and fast' config is used and the task policy records it.
templates.reference: Nessus Advanced Scan: every setting configurable; commonly run with port range 1-65535 and safe checks on.

templates.name: Advanced Dynamic Scan
templates.description: Choose checks by filter (minimum severity, name text, families) instead of fixed families. New checks that match are included after each feed update.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Advanced Dynamic Scan: configure dynamic plugin filters instead of selecting families; new matching plugins are added automatically.
templates.deviations: Filters use Greenbone's own NVT fields (severity, name, family). The default is High and Critical checks (severity 7.0 or more); change it in the policy. Discovery and detection checks the selected checks depend on still run.
templates.reference: Nessus Advanced Dynamic Scan: configure dynamic plugin filters instead of selecting families; new matching plugins are added automatically.

templates.name: Credentialed Patch Audit
templates.description: Log in to hosts and find missing patches. Requires an SMB (Windows) or SSH (Linux/macOS) credential on the scanner.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Credentialed Patch Audit: authenticates over SMB/WMI or SSH and enumerates missing updates; network port scanning is minimal.
templates.deviations: Uses the 52-family catalog ports so SMB, SSH, and WinRM are reachable. The job is refused before scanning if no matching credential reference is configured.
templates.reference: Nessus Credentialed Patch Audit: authenticates over SMB/WMI or SSH and enumerates missing updates; network port scanning is minimal.

templates.name: Credential Validation
templates.description: Check that the SMB (Windows) and/or SSH (Linux/macOS) credentials log in to each target. Light scan on login ports only.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Credential Validation: a lightweight template to verify that Windows and Unix credentials authenticate to scan targets.
templates.deviations: Login results come from Greenbone's Auth-<protocol>-Success/Failure host details. If Greenbone reports neither, the host shows 'no login result reported' rather than a pass.
templates.reference: Nessus Credential Validation: a lightweight template to verify that Windows and Unix credentials authenticate to scan targets.

templates.name: Web Application Tests
templates.description: Scan web servers and applications on common web ports, including TLS configuration.
templates.nessus_reference: Listed in Nessus 10.9 documentation but not in the 10.11 scanner template list; Nessus Expert now provides separate web-app templates.
templates.deviations: OpenVAS does not crawl like Nessus' web application scanner; it runs its web NVT families against detected web servers. Base families (port scanners, service/product detection, settings, general) are always kept.
templates.reference: Listed in Nessus 10.9 documentation but not in the 10.11 scanner template list; Nessus Expert now provides separate web-app templates.

templates.name: Internal PCI Network Scan
templates.description: Internal PCI DSS 11.3.1 vulnerability scan settings. Review results against the PCI threshold: findings with CVSS 4.0 or higher must be remediated.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Internal PCI Network Scan: full vulnerability scan whose results are reviewed against PCI DSS (CVSS 4.0 and above fails).
templates.deviations: Polaron tags findings with PCI requirements but does not compute an automatic pass/fail from CVSS; apply the 4.0 threshold during review. This is not an ASV-certified external scan.
templates.reference: Nessus Internal PCI Network Scan: full vulnerability scan whose results are reviewed against PCI DSS (CVSS 4.0 and above fails).

templates.name: Policy Compliance Auditing
templates.description: Audit system configuration with Greenbone's policy and compliance checks. Needs SMB or SSH credentials.
templates.nessus_reference: Nessus Policy Compliance Auditing: audits system configurations against a known baseline using audit files.
templates.deviations: Greenbone's community compliance checks are far fewer than Nessus audit files (CIS/DISA benchmarks are not included). The job is refused if this feed has none of the compliance families. Most compliance results are informational pass/fail rows.
templates.reference: Nessus Policy Compliance Auditing: audits system configurations against a known baseline using audit files.

templates.name: Threat check: WannaCry / EternalBlue (MS17-010)
templates.description: Check SMB for MS17-010 (EternalBlue) exposure on ports 139 and 445.
templates.nessus_reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.
templates.deviations: Only SMB ports are scanned; a 'no hit' result is not proof the host is patched.
templates.reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.

templates.name: Threat check: Zerologon (CVE-2020-1472)
templates.description: Check domain controllers for Zerologon over RPC/SMB, including the dynamic RPC range. Scans all TCP ports so the dynamic RPC range is reachable.
templates.nessus_reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.
templates.deviations: Target domain controllers explicitly; other hosts will simply show no hit. OpenVAS treats unscanned ports as closed, so the dynamic RPC range (49152-65535) requires an all-TCP scan.
templates.reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.

templates.name: Threat check: PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527)
templates.description: Look for Windows Print Spooler PrintNightmare exposure. Credentials give far better results. Scans all TCP ports so the dynamic RPC range is reachable.
templates.nessus_reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.
templates.deviations: Remote detection is limited without an SMB credential reference. OpenVAS treats unscanned ports as closed, so the dynamic RPC range (49152-65535) requires an all-TCP scan.
templates.reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.

templates.name: Threat check: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228)
templates.description: Look for Apache Log4j Log4Shell exposure across all TCP ports.
templates.nessus_reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.
templates.deviations: Remote checks only find exposed Log4j services; credentials are needed to find vulnerable library files on disk.
templates.reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.

templates.name: Threat check: ProxyLogon (Microsoft Exchange)
templates.description: Check Microsoft Exchange web endpoints for ProxyLogon.
templates.nessus_reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.
templates.deviations: Only Exchange web ports are scanned; target Exchange servers explicitly.
templates.reference: Not a template in the current Nessus 10.11 scanner list. Tenable publishes vulnerability-specific templates separately; this is an Aetheris threat check built from OpenVAS checks and a CVE watchlist.

templates.name: Nexpose · Full audit
templates.description: Rapid7's recommended vulnerability template: every safe network check on the default service ports, with patch checks when credentials are added. Policy (compliance) checks are off, which keeps it faster than Exhaustive.
templates.reference: InsightVM Full audit: full network audit of all systems using only safe checks, including network-based vulnerabilities, patch/hotfix checking and OS-configuration-layer auditing; default ports only; policy checking disabled.
templates.deviations: Default ports are the Aetheris service port policy (95 services, 154 TCP / 33 UDP), not Rapid7's unpublished internal list. Patch/hotfix checks need an SMB or SSH credential, as in Nexpose.

templates.name: Nexpose · Exhaustive
templates.description: Thorough scan of every TCP port (1-65535) and the priority UDP ports with all checks, including policy and inventory checks. Slow: use it on a small number of hosts.
templates.reference: InsightVM Exhaustive: thorough network scan of all systems and services using only safe checks, including patch/hotfix inspection, policy compliance assessment and OS-configuration-layer auditing; can take hours per asset.
templates.deviations: Policy compliance results need SMB/SSH credentials; without them the policy checks report nothing, as in Nexpose.

templates.name: Nexpose · Safe network audit
templates.description: Quick, non-intrusive scan of the service ports using vulnerability checks only. Good for a first look at a network.
templates.reference: InsightVM Safe network audit: non-intrusive scan of all network assets using only safe checks; no in-depth patch/hotfix checking, policy compliance or OS-configuration auditing.
templates.deviations: Greenbone has no separate 'remote-only' switch; local (credentialed) checks simply find nothing when no credential is supplied.

templates.name: Nexpose · Discovery scan
templates.description: Find live hosts, their names and operating systems, and open service ports. No vulnerability checks.
templates.reference: InsightVM Discovery scan: locates live assets and identifies host names and operating systems; no enumeration, policy or vulnerability scanning.
templates.deviations: Greenbone's Discovery config also runs service and product detection on open ports, which is slightly more than Nexpose discovery.

templates.name: Nexpose · Discovery scan (aggressive)
templates.description: Same scope as Discovery scan with faster, more aggressive timing. May trigger IDS/IPS or SYN-flood protection.
templates.reference: InsightVM Discovery scan (aggressive): identical in scope to Discovery scan but uses more threads; may trigger IPS/IDS and exhaust stateful firewalls.
templates.deviations: Speed comes from the Fast performance profile (Nmap Aggressive timing, shorter socket timeouts), not a thread count.

templates.name: Nexpose · Internet DMZ audit
templates.description: Internet-facing services only: web, FTP, mail (SMTP/POP/IMAP/Domino), DNS, databases, Telnet, SSH and VPN. Windows, printer and internal infrastructure services are not scanned.
templates.reference: InsightVM Internet DMZ audit: covers common Internet services (Web, FTP, mail incl. Lotus Notes, DNS, database, Telnet, SSH, VPN); no in-depth patch/hotfix or policy checks.
templates.deviations: Implemented as the service port policy with non-DMZ services switched off (disabled_services).

templates.name: Nexpose · Web audit
templates.description: Web servers and web applications on common web ports, including TLS. No FTP, mail or database checks.
templates.reference: InsightVM Web audit: audit of all web servers and web applications (application servers, ASPs, CGI scripts); no patch checking, policy audits, FTP, mail or database scanning.
templates.deviations: Greenbone has no web spider equivalent to Nexpose's legacy spider; web checks run against the discovered virtual hosts and common paths.

templates.name: Nexpose · Penetration test
templates.description: In-depth safe-check scan of every TCP port to find exposed services before a manual penetration test.
templates.reference: InsightVM Penetration test: in-depth scan of all systems using only safe checks with host-discovery and network-penetration features; no in-depth patch/hotfix, policy or OS-configuration auditing.
templates.deviations: Aetheris only scans the authorized target list; Nexpose's option to discover assets outside the scan scope is deliberately not implemented.

templates.name: Nexpose · Microsoft hotfix
templates.description: Log in to Windows hosts over SMB and report missing Microsoft security updates. Requires an SMB credential.
templates.reference: InsightVM Microsoft hotfix: verifies installation of hotfixes and service packs on Windows; administrative credentials recommended.
templates.deviations: Uses Greenbone's 'Windows : Microsoft Bulletins' and 'Windows' families over SMB; the target must allow SMB (TCP 445) from the scanner.

templates.name: Nexpose · Linux RPMs
templates.description: Log in to Linux hosts over SSH and report missing RPM security updates. Requires an SSH credential.
templates.reference: InsightVM Linux RPMs: verifies proper installation of RPM patches on Linux systems; administrative credentials recommended.
templates.deviations: Greenbone evaluates installed packages through its local security checks (LSC/Notus) after SSH login; all check families stay enabled so Notus advisories are not filtered out.

templates.name: Nexpose · PCI ASV external audit
templates.description: PCI DSS external vulnerability scan: every TCP port and the well-known UDP ports, safe checks only. Findings with CVSS 4.0 or higher fail PCI.
templates.reference: InsightVM PCI ASV external audit: safe-check PCI audit including network vulnerabilities and patch verification; all TCP ports and well-known UDP ports; no policy checks.
templates.deviations: Aetheris is not an Approved Scanning Vendor; use this to prepare for the ASV scan, not to replace it.

templates.name: Nexpose · PCI internal audit
templates.description: Internal PCI DSS scan: network vulnerabilities on the service ports plus web application checks on common web ports.
templates.reference: InsightVM PCI internal audit: all network-based vulnerabilities plus web application scanning for internal PCI DSS scans; excludes potential and external-perimeter-only vulnerabilities.
templates.deviations: Greenbone has no 'potential vulnerability' class; low-confidence results are kept and labelled with their quality of detection (QoD).

templates.name: Nexpose · HIPAA compliance
templates.description: Safe-check audit for HIPAA 164.312 technical safeguards: access control, auditing, integrity, authentication and transmission security (encryption).
templates.reference: InsightVM HIPAA compliance: safe-check audit of HIPAA section 164.312 (Technical Safeguards) flagging inadequate access control, auditing, integrity, authentication or transmission security.
templates.deviations: Runs the full check set and tags the job HIPAA; the HIPAA mapping of each finding is a reporting step, as in Nexpose.

templates.name: Nexpose · Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance
templates.description: Safe-check audit for SOX sections 302, 404 and 409: data integrity, access auditing, accountability and availability.
templates.reference: InsightVM SOX compliance: safe-check audit of all systems for threats to data integrity, access auditing, accountability and availability (sections 302, 404, 409).
templates.deviations: Runs the full check set and tags the job SOX; SOX control mapping is a reporting step.

templates.name: Nexpose · SCADA audit
templates.description: Polite scan of industrial control systems (Modbus, S7, DNP3, IEC-104, EtherNet/IP, BACnet, Niagara Fox) with safe checks and standard timing.
templates.reference: InsightVM SCADA audit: 'polite' safe-check audit of SCADA systems with longer packet delays, protocol handshaking disabled and restricted simultaneous access.
templates.deviations: Uses Standard timing and safe checks; Greenbone cannot disable protocol handshaking per protocol. Schedule it in a maintenance window.

templates.name: Nexpose · CIS
templates.description: Configuration compliance against CIS-style benchmarks using Greenbone's policy checks. No vulnerability checks. Requires SMB or SSH credentials.
templates.reference: InsightVM CIS: Policy Manager scan evaluating system and service settings against CIS (and DISA) benchmarks; requires administrative credentials; no vulnerability checks.
templates.deviations: Greenbone's community feed ships fewer benchmark policies than Rapid7 Policy Manager; results cover the Policy/Compliance checks present in the feed.

templates.name: Nexpose · DISA
templates.description: DISA STIG-style configuration compliance using Greenbone's policy checks on default ports. No vulnerability checks. Requires SMB or SSH credentials.
templates.reference: InsightVM DISA: DISA policy compliance with OS-configuration-layer auditing on DISA-benchmarked systems; administrative credentials required; default ports only; no vulnerability checks.
templates.deviations: Coverage is limited to the STIG-derived policy checks in the Greenbone feed.

templates.name: Nexpose · Denial of service (UNSAFE)
templates.description: UNSAFE: runs denial-of-service checks that can crash or hang services. Use only in a pre-production environment with written approval.
templates.reference: InsightVM Denial of service: basic audit using both safe and unsafe (denial-of-service) checks, intended for pre-production testing of resistance to DoS conditions.
templates.deviations: Never created automatically; a policy manager must create it explicitly.

templates.name: Aetheris · TLS/SSL & SWEET32 focus
templates.description: Focused TLS/SSL configuration audit across every TLS- and STARTTLS-bearing service port (not just 443): HTTPS, SMTP/POP3/IMAP STARTTLS, LDAP/LDAPS, database TLS (MSSQL/MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB), message-broker TLS, WinRM HTTPS and FTPS. Runs the Greenbone 'SSL and TLS' NVT family to detect SWEET32 (64-bit block / 3DES cipher acceptance), SSLv2/SSLv3, weak/anonymous/NULL/RC4 ciphers, and certificate problems. SSH family is included so OpenSSH/Dropbear algorithm and version weaknesses from the reference report are also covered.
templates.reference: Aetheris TLS/SSL focus built from the Aetheris scanner implementation guide (section 9: TLS/SSL and SWEET32) and the Fund Fox gap report (SSL Version 2/3 detection, SSL medium-strength ciphers / SWEET32). Not a Nessus or Nexpose built-in template.
templates.deviations: OpenVAS negotiates each protocol natively via its 'SSL and TLS' family rather than sending a raw ClientHello to every port; unsupported negotiations remain a coverage gap, not a pass. SWEET32 is reported as acceptance of a 64-bit block cipher (3DES) in the negotiated suite. Credentials are not required.

templates.name: Aetheris · PDF reference audit (Fund Fox)
templates.description: Comprehensive unauthenticated audit scoped to the Aetheris scanner implementation guide's 52-service matrix and all eight Fund Fox finding types: SSLv2/SSLv3 detection, SWEET32 / medium-strength ciphers, OpenSSH (X11 forwarding bypass and pre-10.3 advisories), Dropbear (<2016.72 and <2013.59), Windows SMB share access, and IP forwarding. Scans the full service port policy plus every TLS-bearing port, pinning the SSL/TLS, SSH, Web and Windows NVT families. Add an SMB/SSH credential for missing-patch and configuration checks.
templates.reference: Aetheris reference audit built from the Aetheris scanner implementation guide (v2.0, 52-service matrix) and the Fund Fox gap assessment (eight finding types). Not a Nessus or Nexpose built-in template; maps the reference findings to Greenbone NVT families rather than reproducing Tenable plugins or severity.
templates.deviations: Unauthenticated by default: it reports what is reachable over the network. Missing-patch (High/Critical) and SMB share-permission findings need an SMB or SSH credential, exactly as noted in the guide. IP forwarding is a host configuration check that needs authenticated evidence; it is reported not-tested without credentials. Exact CVSS/severity parity with the report is not asserted.

not_supported.reason: Federal Desktop Core Configuration for Windows XP/Vista; Greenbone ships no FDCC content.
US Government Configuration Baseline for Windows 7; Greenbone ships no USGCB content.
Deprecated by Rapid7 when the web spider was removed; use Nexpose · Full audit.
